summary: Diagnosed and fixed two layout regressions in the Gizmo web app: unstyled buttons (Vite dropped the second nested CSS import from the design package, so components kept native browser styling) and a missing composer/non-scrollable chat (the app shell used percentage heights against a wrapper without a fixed height, letting the transcript overflow the viewport). The fix explicitly imports `packages/design/src/components.css` from the app entry and constrains the shell to `100dvh` with overflow hidden.
decisions: Load shared component CSS via a relative import from `apps/app/src/main.ts` (`import '../../../packages/design/src/components.css'`) instead of an `@gizmo/design/component-styles` package export, because Vite was dropping the second nested `@import` in `@gizmo/design/index.css`.
Reverted the attempted `./component-styles` export in `packages/design/package.json` after discovering it caused Vite to return HTTP 500 for `/src/main.ts`.
Constrained `[data-ui='app-shell']` to `width: 100%; height: 100dvh; max-height: 100dvh; overflow: hidden;` so the inner transcript area scrolls and the composer stays anchored.
errors: Headless Chrome (`chrome.exe`) crashed with exit code 3221225794; switched to headless Microsoft Edge which succeeded.

Edge `--remote-debugging-port` probe returned `undefined` on the first attempt (process killed before WebSocket connected), and a second attempt with a fresh user-data-dir produced `ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:9223` because the previous debug process was still exiting.

Vite returned HTTP 500 for `/src/main.ts` with `"./component-styles" is not...` after adding the new subpath export, even after `pnpm install`; resolved by removing the export and using a direct relative CSS import.
